direct_target: observed rainfall minus leave-one-out training climatology
residual_target: observed rainfall minus chronological out-of-fit hybrid forecast
residual_reconstruction: maximum(0, fully refitted hybrid + neural correction)
selection: fixed eight epochs; no inner or outer checkpoint selection
shared: same 120 target months, 31 input maps, scaling, initialization, minibatch order, architecture and optimizer
crossfit: five expanding/rolling hybrid fits, each cutoff four months before its first forecast target; never use an in-sample hybrid error
reference: exact existing hybrid, with complete 30-year climatologies; fail on insufficient history
scope: previously consulted development block; no independent holdout
transfer_limit: earlier hybrid fits have different training cutoffs; their error distribution may differ from the final refit
